correctness.rationale: For the rational shift Sigma(k/(k+1)) with k>=1, the invariant-support theorem of Reyes reduces all positive-[10]-frequency ergodic measures to returns 0^m1^(km). The roof is (k+1)m, one-generator edge counts are (m-1,1,1,km-1), and energy is m(a+kd)+(b+c-a-d). Abramov/Kac identities plus H(return process)<=H(one-letter marginal), followed by KL divergence against q_m=e^s exp[-m log(1+e^s)], prove the sharp bulk free energy R=(a+kd+log(1+e^s))/(k+1); iid geometric returns alone attain equality. Measures with [10]=0 are the two fixed-point atoms. Ergodic decomposition gives exactly max(a,d,R), all equilibrium mixtures and transverse coexistence; direct algebra gives both freezing roots. Independent finite check covered 20 (k,a,b,c,d) choices and transition identities; it does not prove all k or potentials.
